text: C2 review follow-ups (branch review/c2-provenance-v2-20261004): (1) ParametricHrfFamily is unsealed; kernel-basis/v2 identifies a family by name + chart + horizon only, so a custom family reusing a shipped name with a different evalInto would collide. Shipped families are fully identified by those fields. Fix options: seal the family set, or require families to expose a versioned structural identity. (2) condition-profile/v2 encodes TrialQueries' ProfileTrialAxis only by trial/condition counts (the axis is bound by reference identity); unreachable today because ConditionProfileFit.prepare refuses trial outputs before provenance exists. (3) Reusable encoders for the profile-fit/v2 and geometry fix now exist: fit ResponsePreparationIdentity.provenance (response-preparation/v1), ConditionProfileProvenance.budgetCanonical/priorCanonical/outputCanonical, and KernelBasisProvenance.{number,field,record,option,matrix} (matrix = dims + FNV-1a64 over IEEE bits).
